validation.earlier_queue_and_priority_combined: 31 passed in1.64 seconds before final systemctl placement; final targeted tests verify helpers run at original priority before/after the scope

priority_scope.scope: Only the fresh probe TGID and its self-task threads, freshly checked through /proc/self/task before each mutation
priority_scope.applied_before: ORT/NumPy/sherpa model-runtime imports and new native worker threads
priority_scope.restore: finally restores each surviving original thread's original nice, and new live runtime threads to original main-thread nice; restoration failure reports FAILED
priority_scope.recorded: Original, effective, finishing and restored nice/count distributions plus restoration confirmation and permission refusal
priority_scope.permission_failure: Refuse before any model import/load; partial application is restored, never silently downgraded or retried with different privileges
priority_scope.subprocess_helpers: Outer safety systemctl show calls run before nice and after successful restoration; inside experiment only fixed-loopback HTTP and boot/device protection checks run
priority_scope.tuning_metadata: system_tuning reflects actual own-priority changes; systemwide_tuning=false. Negative-nice runs do not claim system_tuning=false.

context.display: Actual state.avatar_display numeric pushed/received/sequence/fps/p50_ms/p95_ms/p99_ms/max_ms/age_ms with native_sink_handoff kind
context.identity: Only numeric processed/discarded/pending_frames/last_inference_ms and face_targets numeric counters; no person IDs/templates/names/images
context.comparisons: Per-run before/after native rolling FPS/P95 and identity workload counters, clearly snapshots rather than whole-trial distributions
context.self_scheduler: Per-run process CPU seconds, wall-minus-process-CPU, common self-task schedstat runtime/runqueue wait/timeslices and voluntary/involuntary context switches. Kernel schedstat wait can be disabled; sleep/synchronization is not equivalent to runqueue wait.

acceptance: This remains an isolated diagnostic. The parent must compare matched workload and then pass original paced capture plus UI/camera behavior; higher priority or more buffering alone is not realtime acceptance.
